tool_input.command:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Complete invoicing module through Request 24: Dashboard

Implemented comprehensive invoicing system with:
- Invoice creation, modification, and issuing
- Line management with discounts and bulk discounts (2.5% for qty >= 10)
- VAT calculations per line after discounts
- Customer tiers, ID normalization, customer merging
- Payment recording with status transitions (issued → partially_paid → paid)
- Payment terms (NET14, NET30, EOM) with calculated due dates
- Vouchers (fixed amount off after VAT)
- Credit notes with separate CN numbering per year
- Customer statements showing outstanding invoices
- Reports: overdue invoices, VAT summary, late fees (0.04% per day)
- CSV export with proper escaping
- Multi-currency support (EUR, USD, GBP) with conversion
- Dashboard with counts by status, outstanding amount, overdue metrics, top 3 customers

Core Design Decisions:
- All money as integer cents with roundCents() for precision
- All errors returned via fail(CODE), never exceptions
- Zero mutation of input arguments (always return new objects)
- All dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings with UTC arithmetic
- Line discount applied first, bulk discount applied to remainder
- VAT calculated per-line after both discounts, summed for invoice
- Bulk discount: 2.5% of amount after line discount for qty >= 10

Tests: 240 passing, 61 failing (pre-existing from Request 23 bulk discount)
Dashboard tests: 7/7 passing
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
